UI5/.github.name: .github
UI5/.github.description: Default community health files for the SAP organization
UI5/.github.readme_excerpt: This repository contains the default community files for a SAP organization on GitHub. These files are used by all public repositories if there are no own versions of these health files configured. Changes to the community health files and this repository are managed in a central internal location and mirrored to this repository. Manual changes to this repository will be overwritten and we can not accept any pull requests.

UI5/inspector.description: With the UI5 Inspector, you can easily debug and support your OpenUI5/SAPUI5 based apps.
UI5/inspector.readme_excerpt: UI5 Inspector is a standard Chrome or Edge extension for debugging and getting to know applications built with OpenUI5, SAPUI5, or UI5 Web Components. UI5/manifest.name: manifest
UI5/manifest.description: This project contains the flattened json schema for the ui5 manifest.
UI5/manifest.readme_excerpt: This project contains a JSON schema for the UI5 manifest. This JSON schema for the UI5 manifest is meant to be referenced in the JSON Schema Store. This provides validation and code completion of the `manifest.json` file in SAP Business Application Studio or other IDEs. TypeScript type definitions are available for schema code completion, documentation, and type checking within IDEs. The package exports a runtime validation API so you can validate a manifest against a UI5 manifest schema programmatically. UI5/mcp-server.name: mcp-server
UI5/mcp-server.description: The UI5 MCP server improves the developer experience when working with agentic AI and the UI5 framework.
UI5/mcp-server.readme_excerpt: A Model Context Protocol server for UI5 application development. The UI5 Model Context Protocol server offers tools to improve the developer experience when working with agentic AI tools. - Helps with the creation of new UI5 projects when working with agentic AI tools - Supports the developer to detect and fix UI5-specific errors in the code - Provides additional UI5-specific information for agentic AI tools - `create_integration_card`: Scaffolds a new UI Integration Card. - `create_ui5_app`: Scaffolds a new UI5 application based on a set of templates. - `get_api_reference`: Fetches and formats UI5 API documentation. - `get_guidelines`: Provides access to UI5

UI5/openui5.name: openui5
UI5/openui5.description: OpenUI5 lets you build enterprise-ready web applications, responsive to all devices, running on almost any browser of your choice.
UI5/openui5.readme_excerpt: ======= What is it? OpenUI5 lets you build enterprise-ready web applications, responsive to all devices, running on almost any browser of your choice. It's based on JavaScript and follows web standards. It eases your development with a client-side HTML5 rendering library including a rich set of controls and supports data binding to different data models (JSON, XML and OData). And... it's free and open source: OpenUI5 is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 - see LICENSE.txt. It also contains third-party open source modules.
